user.title: ThroughTek SDK
user.description: This integration needs ThroughTek's SDK libraries, which it can't include. They are in ThroughTek's {app} app for Android. Download its {abi} variant as an XAPK file, as the integration's README describes, and upload it here. Only the four SDK libraries (version {required}) are kept; the rest of the file is deleted.

camera.title: Camera pairing QR
camera.description: On the parent unit, open the camera's "Connect Mobile Phone" pairing QR code. Scan it with any phone QR-code reader and paste the text it shows (a long base64 string) here.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The camera is not accepting the stored credentials. They change whenever the camera's Wi-Fi changes or its security key is updated. Scan the current pairing QR code on the parent unit and paste its text here.

error.not_a_package: This isn't an Android app. Upload the .xapk or .apk file as downloaded.
error.wrong_arch: This file has no SDK libraries for this Home Assistant host ({arch}). Libraries it does have: {found}. Download the {abi} variant of {app}.
error.missing_libraries: This app doesn't contain the ThroughTek SDK libraries. Upload {app}.
error.wrong_version: The SDK libraries in this file are version {version}, but this integration needs version {required}. Download {app}.
error.sdk_error: The SDK could not be prepared: {error}
error.sdk_unavailable: The SDK could not be loaded; see the logs.
error.invalid_qr: This is not a VTech pairing QR code. Paste the full text the QR reader shows.
error.wrong_camera: This QR code belongs to a different camera.
error.invalid_auth: The camera rejected the credentials from this QR code. Scan the QR again; it changes after a Wi-Fi change.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the camera. Make sure it is powered on and on the same network as Home Assistant. If its Wi-Fi changed recently, scan a fresh QR code.
error.invalid_license: The SDK rejected its license key.

abort.unsupported_host: This Home Assistant host's processor isn't supported yet: the integration runs on x86_64 (64-bit PC) only.
abort.already_configured: This camera is already configured; its credentials were updated.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to use the new VTech SDK
restart_required.description: The SDK libraries or the integration's companion library changed, but the old ones are already loaded and cannot be replaced while Home Assistant runs. Restart Home Assistant to apply them.

get_motion_events.name: Get motion events
get_motion_events.description: Returns the camera's stored motion history (the camera stores motion only), newest first.
